title: create_complaint_with_valid_data
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint endpoint with valid complaint details including title, description, category, coordinates, and optional photos to verify successful complaint creation with correct village routing and receipt of complaint_id and ticket_id.

title: create_complaint_with_anonymous_submission
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint endpoint with valid complaint details and anonymous submission fields to ensure complaint is created without exposing reporter identity and returns success with a generated ticket_id.

title: create_complaint_with_invalid_or_missing_fields
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint endpoint with missing or invalid title, category, or location fields to verify the API returns success false with an appropriate error message and does not create a complaint.

title: create_complaint_with_unresolvable_coordinates
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_create_complaint endpoint with coordinates that do not resolve to a known village boundary to confirm the API returns success false or an error indicating routing failure and prevents complaint creation until valid village context is provided.

title: join_village_with_valid_code_authenticated
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_join_village endpoint with a valid join code while authenticated to verify the user becomes a member of the village and receives success true with village_id and village_name.

title: join_village_with_invalid_code_authenticated
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_join_village endpoint with an invalid or expired join code while authenticated to ensure the API returns success false with an error message and the user remains unassigned to any village.

title: join_village_without_authentication
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_join_village endpoint without authentication to verify the API returns an authorization failure and does not change village membership.

title: approve_admin_request_with_valid_request_super_admin
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_approve_admin_request endpoint with a valid request_id as a super admin to confirm the requested user is promoted to village admin and the response includes success true, village details, join_code, and user_id.

title: reject_admin_request_with_valid_request_super_admin
description: Test the POST /rpc/svc_reject_admin_request endpoint with a valid request_id as a super admin to verify the admin promotion request is rejected successfully with success true and no promotion occurs.

title: get_current_village_join_code_with_valid_village_admin
description: Test the POST /rpc/get_current_village_join_code endpoint with a valid village id as an authenticated admin to ensure the current join code string is returned for administrative sharing.
